title: Gemini VII air-to-ground transcript - 5011500_VolumeI
doc_notes: This document is a declassified air-to-ground voice communication transcript for the Gemini VII mission, containing routine flight operations, technical troubleshooting, and two specific reports of unidentified objects or phenomena. / This document is a transcript of air-to-ground communications for the Gemini VII mission, containing routine operational updates and one report of an unidentified object observed by the crew. / This document is a transcript of air-to-ground communications for the Gemini VII mission, containing routine flight operations, medical checks, and minor observations of objects in space. / This document is a transcript of air-to-ground communications from the Gemini VII mission, containing routine operational updates, medical checks, and observations of atmospheric phenomena; pages 339 and 340 are blank or illegible.

incidents.summary: Astronauts observe a 'bogey' at 10:00 o'clock high and numerous particles.
incidents.quote: I have a bogey at 10:00 o'clock high.

incidents.summary: Astronauts observe a strap or piece of tape attached to the spacecraft during a burn.
behavior: slapped on the front of the spacecraft
incidents.quote: It looked like a strap of some sort and I believe it was attached to the spacecraft.

incidents.summary: Astronauts observe a jagged, white, rubbery material drifting outside the Gemini VII window.
incidents.explanation: The crew speculated it was a separation plane, while ground control suggested it might be radiator stripping.
incidents.quote: It's some light - looks like white, rubbery material.

incidents.summary: Gemini VII crew observed a satellite moving below the spacecraft during a urine dump.
incidents.quote: I took a picture of a satellite moving below us.

incidents.summary: Gemini VII crew observes sunrise and airglow phenomena from orbit, noting color bands and cloud formations on the horizon.
incidents.color: blue, orange, red, yellow, green, purple
incidents.explanation: Atmospheric refraction and scattering during sunrise.
